svg.title: The life of an issue and its labels
svg.desc: A new issue gets needs-triage, the labels of its form and a first analysis, and the maintainer takes over. When information is missing, or the maintainer asks the reporter, it gets needs-info and waits for the reporter: on day 15 it gets stale and a reminder, and on day 30 it closes as not planned; an answer, also after the closing, brings it back to the maintainer. A sure duplicate gets possible-duplicate and a notice and closes as a duplicate on day 3, unless an objection, a comment or a thumbs down of the reporter or of someone who may push, brings it back to the maintainer. A merged fix gives it fixed-in-next-release, and the release closes it with a link; a comment within 30 days that it is still broken brings it back to the maintainer.
